### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one proteinannotator run (qc/, domain_annotation/, functional_annotation/, s4pred/, pipeline_info/) |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV or CSV): sample id in the first column (or a column named sample), one column per factor. Enables the design filter and the design card. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table sample-id column (links join on it). Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group and filter by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `SKIP_INTERPROSCAN` | — | Set (--var SKIP_INTERPROSCAN=true) for a run with --skip_interproscan: no functional_annotation/, so the InterProScan collections are pruned. |
| `SKIP_S4PRED` | — | Set (--var SKIP_S4PRED=true) for a run with --skip_s4pred: no s4pred/, so the secondary-structure collections are pruned (the residue table keeps its sequence and domains). |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`hmmer/hmmsearch_domtbl.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hmmer/hmmsearch_domtbl.py) | One row per domain hit of an ``hmmsearch --domtblout`` table. | `entity`, `sample`, `source`, `label`, `accession`, `description`, `start`, `end`, `protein_length`, `hmm_length`, `domain_index`, `domain_count`, `seq_evalue`, `seq_score`, `c_evalue`, `i_evalue`, `dom_score`, `dom_bias`, `hmm_from`, `hmm_to`, `ali_from`, `ali_to`, `acc`, `hmm_coverage`, `neg_log10_evalue` |
| [`interproscan/matches.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/interproscan/matches.py) | One row per InterProScan signature match, from the headerless TSV output. | `entity`, `sample`, `source`, `label`, `description`, `start`, `end`, `evalue`, `protein_length`, `interpro_accession`, `interpro_description`, `go_terms`, `pathways` |
| [`proteinannotator/database_coverage.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinannotator/database_coverage.py) | Protein x database matrix: the share of each protein a database annotates. | `entity`, `sample`, `pfam`, `funfam`, `nmpfams`, `metagroot`, `interproscan` |
| [`proteinannotator/database_sets.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinannotator/database_sets.py) | Protein x database membership: 1 when a database annotates the protein. | `entity`, `sample`, `pfam`, `funfam`, `nmpfams`, `metagroot`, `interproscan` |
| [`proteinannotator/domains.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinannotator/domains.py) | Every domain of every searched database in one domain table. | `domain_id`, `entity`, `sample`, `database`, `source`, `label`, `description`, `start`, `end`, `span`, `protein_length`, `evalue`, `neg_log10_evalue`, `score`, `hmm_coverage`, `accession` |
| [`proteinannotator/proteins.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinannotator/proteins.py) | One row per protein: length, domain hits per database, cover, structure. | `entity`, `sample`, `description`, `length`, `annotation_status`, `domain_hits`, `databases_hit`, `pfam_hits`, `funfam_hits`, `nmpfams_hits`, `metagroot_hits`, `interproscan_hits`, `annotated_residues`, `annotated_pct`, `top_domain`, `top_domain_database`, `top_domain_evalue`, `helix_pct`, `strand_pct`, `coil_pct` |
| [`proteinannotator/residues.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinannotator/residues.py) | The residue table of every protein: sequence, secondary structure, domains. | `entity`, `sample`, `position`, `residue`, `category`, `value`, `domain`, `domain_database`, `domains_here`, `sequence` |
| [`proteinannotator/sample_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinannotator/sample_summary.py) | The sample hub: one row per sample of the run, every per-sample number. | `sample_id`, `input_sequences`, `kept_sequences`, `removed_sequences`, `kept_residues`, `mean_length`, `n50`, `min_length`, `max_length`, `annotated_proteins`, `annotated_protein_pct`, `domain_hits`, `median_annotated_pct` |
| [`s4pred/secondary_structure.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/s4pred/secondary_structure.py) | One row per residue of an S4PRED ss2 file (PSIPRED VFORMAT). | `entity`, `sample`, `position`, `residue`, `ss_code`, `category`, `value`, `p_coil`, `p_helix`, `p_strand` |
| [`seqfu/stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seqfu/stats.py) | One row per file SeqFu ``stats`` summarised, with its sample and stage. | `sample`, `stage`, `file`, `sequences`, `total_length`, `mean_length`, `n50`, `n75`, `n90`, `aun`, `min_length`, `max_length` |
| [`seqkit/sequences.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seqkit/sequences.py) | One row per FASTA record: id, description, length and sequence. | `entity`, `sample`, `description`, `length`, `sequence` |
